name: Chloramphenicol Ophthalmic Solution 15 ml 1 Piece
description: Chloramphenicol ophthalmic solution is an antibiotic used to treat external bacterial infections of the eye, such as conjunctivitis, blepharitis, and keratitis. It is usually available in a concentration of 5 mg/ml, and the 15 ml presentation is very common. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
